data.body: Fixed: PR #236 merged to main as 52991360fd. The compliance-verifier hook now auto-skips when (dso.workflow=ci-pr) AND running in a git worktree AND DSO_COMPLIANCE_VERIFIER_ENABLED is unset. Primary checkout still enforces. Existing 15-test hook test suite passes unchanged. Bonus: rolled in the .test-index RED marker fixes (cycle-ledger-migration, scan-red-markers) + S5.T1/S6.T1 recovery patch + cafb change-detector regression fix from S1.T5.
